south-africa-garden-route-high-and-coast.title: South Africa · Garden Route High and Coast
south-africa-garden-route-high-and-coast.slogan: A 634 km loop out of Outeniqua Pass
south-africa-garden-route-high-and-coast.story: Forest, passes and sea towns stitched into a touring week. A one-way ride of 634 km, George to George - roughly 12 h 12 in the saddle. On the way it passes Wilderness beach, Knysna lagoon, Tsitsikamma forest and back through Knysna lagoon. It is a high-mountain day.

scenicChapters.title: Garden Route
scenicChapters.narrative: For 38 km this is Garden Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Seven Passes Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 100 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Cody → Dead Indian Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 48 km. 2451 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Chief Joseph Scenic Byway
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2451 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

chief-joseph-scenic-byway.story: 120 km one way from Cody - plan on about 1 h 58 of riding. The stops in between: Dead Indian Pass and Sunlight Basin. The highest point is about 2,850 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
